items.summary: Nam finds his grandfather's old bicycle with two paper wings taped to the frame, and it flies over the rooftops of the old quarter. Follow him past the lake, the wind and the moment he thinks he is lost. After reading, you can retell the flight, use five new words about flying in your own sentences, and say why the bicycle needed a second pair of hands.
items.title: The Flying Bicycle Adventure

items.summary: Hà finds a castle that only appears to children who come with empty hands, and she spends one whole day inside it. Follow her through the kitchen, the library and the garden, and to the great door with the small slot. After reading, you can retell the day, use five new castle words in your own sentences, and explain what the castle gave back.
items.title: One Day in a Magical Castle

items.summary: A girl climbs into a rocket and flies all the way to the Moon. Follow her through the countdown, the long dark sky and the quiet grey surface. After reading, you can retell the trip, use five new space words in your own sentences, and explain why the Moon feels light and bouncy.
items.title: A Trip to the Moon

items.summary: Bảo walks into a green valley where dinosaurs still walk, and finds something small under a big leaf. Follow her past the ferns, the giant footprints and the warm nests. After reading, you can retell the journey, use five new dinosaur words in your own sentences, and explain why she left the bone in the ground.
items.title: A Journey Through Dinosaur Land

items.summary: A boy finds an old green door in the garden wall and opens it into a garden that should not exist. Follow him past the ivy, through the hidden garden and to the surprise waiting at the end. After reading, you can retell the adventure, use five new garden words in your own sentences, and explain why he keeps the door a secret.
items.title: The Secret Door in the Garden

items.summary: Tuấn finds an old map in his grandmother's attic and walks across the hill to look for buried treasure. Follow him through three clues, a compass with a shaky needle and a long afternoon of digging. After reading, you can retell the hunt, use five new explorer words in your own sentences, and say what the real treasure was.
items.title: The Little Explorer and the Hidden Treasure

items.summary: A small robot called Bit leaves the workshop to find a friend, and nothing goes the way it planned. Follow him through the street, the rain and the park at night. After reading, you can retell the adventure, use five new robot words in your own sentences, and explain how Bit finally made a friend.
items.title: The Robot Who Wanted a Friend

items.summary: A girl puts on her diving mask and swims down to the coral reef for the very first time. Follow her through the shallow water, the dark blue middle and the reef at the bottom. After reading, you can retell the adventure, use five new sea words in your own sentences, and explain why you should never touch a living coral.
items.title: My First Adventure Under the Sea
